title: data/n8n-sync.json
description: The collector watching itself. Written by src/n8n/collect.js on every pass and rendered as its own panel, because a monitoring system that quietly stops monitoring is worse than not having one — the page would keep showing yesterday's healthy numbers with nothing saying they were yesterday's.

tz.description: The zone bucket keys are gridded in

workflows.description: How many were monitored this pass

added.description: New executions collected across every workflow

detailed.description: How many got node-level item counts

apiMs.description: Total time spent inside n8n this pass

registryErrors.description: Rejected registry entries. A workflow silently dropped for a typo looks exactly like a workflow that never runs, so these are surfaced rather than skipped.

instances.description: One reachability check per instance per pass, not per workflow: thirteen workflows on a dead n8n are one outage, not thirteen.

source.description: Which driver read it. sqlite reads n8n's database with a read-only SELECT over SSH and needs no API key at all; api is the public REST API.

baseUrl.description: For api: the loopback URL. For sqlite: a human description of the container and host. No API key or SSH key is ever stored here
